real: All brain images and all numbers are computed from public data (HCP group z map WM 2-back minus 0-back; MNI152NLin6Asym T1w and mask; Harvard-Oxford subcortical th25; fsLR 32k midthickness; HippUnfold MNI152NLin6Asym surfaces, subfields and unfolded template). Thalamus 1.33/1.33 and putamen 1.83/1.83 were rechecked: per-hemisphere means are 1.328 vs 1.334 and 1.828 vs 1.834; the group map is near-symmetric there.
mocked: Static HTML shell modelled on the real Integrated layout; nothing is interactive; offline software rasteriser.

states.main: Hippocampus selected. Left: cortex and white matter cut by a plane across the hippocampal long axis, 18 mm from the head; hippocampus (HippUnfold surface, ribbon mean, subfield lines), thalamus, caudate and putamen (mask-boundary meshes, vertex samples) stay whole and come through the face; green ring where the plane crosses the hippocampus; drawn long axis with stop ticks and a handle; faint outline of the removed half. Right: the face flat with leaders to left and right zooms (x3.3), and uncut laterals with the plane trace, stops, hippocampus outline and the removed side dimmed. Dock: per hemisphere, structure crops at each stop tied to their graticule line; unfolded sheet with subfield atlas lines, dashed graticule of the other stops, green trace of the cut, brushed band between 8 and 28 mm; subfield dot plot (this side filled, other hollow, grey when below threshold); column-mean profile on the sheet's own axis with the cut drawn as the span its trace covers and mm ticks placed where each stop's trace falls.
states.thalamus: Thalamus selected, as the no-template-surface case: coronal cut 16 mm from the anterior pole, structures whole, zooms on the thalami. Dock: per hemisphere a sagittal long-axis section in the section language with stop lines, and the mask-mean profile beneath on the same millimetre axis.

decisions: Cut the cortex, not the structure: structures are separate meshes drawn uncut after the cap.
Sheet axis is percent along the unfolded long axis; millimetres along the straight axis appear as an uneven tick row and as graticule curves on the sheet.
Whole-brain strip removed; its stops are ticks on the drawn axis, the laterals and the graticule.
Stipple replaced by thin signed threshold contours in unlabelled tissue more than 4.5 mm from cortex.
Sheet keeps the thresholded colour scale used everywhere else; sub-threshold marginal values are greyed instead of drawing an unthresholded sheet.
Brush is an interval on the sheet's own axis (25 to 50 percent), a rectangle on the sheet and the same x extent on the profile.
Counts are given as volume (label grid 1 mm) and approximate map voxels (2 mm); grids are named in the inspector.
Camera frames the deep structures at about 1.4 times the round-2 scale; whole-brain context is carried by the uncut laterals.
Structure meshes are nearly unlit and sampled 2 mm inside the mask boundary.
A structure pair that meets at the midline gets one bilateral zoom.
